blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing Knowledge Distillation (KD) methods for semantic segmentation often guide the student to mimic the teacher's structured information generated from an individual image. However, they ignore the global semantic relations across various images that are valuable for KD. This paper proposes Cross-Image Relational KD V2 (CIRKDV2), which focuses on transferring structured pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations modeled from global images in the dataset. A large teacher network often constructs a well-structured feature space in terms of global contextual dependencies. CIRKDV2 makes the student mimic the better structured semantic relations of the teacher, thus improving the feature representational capability. Beyond relational distillation, we further propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings to match the semantic level with the teacher. This avoids the semantic gap problem between the teacher and student occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. Experimental results on Cityscapes, ADE20K, Pascal VOC, and COCO-Stuff-164K demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art semantic segmentation distillation methods by large margins across various network architectures. Our code and pre-trained models are publicly available at https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD.
blocks.zh: 现有的知识分解(KD)方法用于语义分解,经常会引导学生模仿老师从个人形象中生成的结构化信息. 然而,它们忽略了对KD有价值的各种图像的全球语义关系. 本文提出跨图像关系KD V2(CIRKDV2),重点是将结构化的像素到像素,像素到区域,以及从数据集中的全局图像所建模的通道到通道关系. 大型教师网络往往从全球背景依赖性的角度构建出结构完善的特色空间. CIRKDV2使学生模仿教师结构较好的语义关系,从而提升了特色表现能力. 除了亲和分馏之外,我们进一步提出背景特征分馏,利用上下文聚合来增强学生像素嵌入,使语义层次与老师相匹配. 这避免了传统特征分解研究中发生的师生间语义差距问题. 关于Cityscapes,ADE20K,Pascal VOC,和COCO-Stuff-164K的实验结果显示,CIRKDV2通过跨越各种网络架构的大幅差幅来超越最先进的语义分解分解法. 我们的代码和预先训练过的模型可在https://github.com/winycg/CIRKD上公开查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation is a crucial and challenging task in computer vision. It aims to classify each pixel in the input image with an individual category label. The applications of segmentation often focus on autonomous driving, virtual reality, and robot navigation. Although popular state-of-the-art segmentation networks, such as DeepLab [ 1 , 2 ] , PSPNet [ 3 ] , and SAM [ 4 ] , achieve remarkable performance, they are often equipped with large image encoders, leading to high computational costs. This weakness makes them difficult to deploy for real-world scenarios on resource-limited mobile devices. Model compression is an effective way to pursue compact networks, mainly divided into quantization [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] , pruning [ 8 , 9 ] , and knowledge distillation (KD) [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 语义分化是计算机视觉中一项关键而具有挑战性的任务. 它旨在将输入图像中的每个像素以单个类别标签分类. 分块化的应用往往侧重于自主驱动,虚拟现实,和机器人导航. 虽然流行的"最先进的分块"网络,如DeepLab [1,2],PSPNet [3],和SAM [4],都取得了出众的性能,但它们经常配备了大型的图像编码器,导致高昂的计算成本. 这一弱点使它们难以在资源有限的移动设备上用于现实世界的情景。 模型压缩是追求紧凑网络的一种有效方式,主要分为量化[5,6,7],挤压[8,9],和知识分馏(KD)[10,11,12].

blocks.en: This paper investigates KD to improve the performance of a compact student network under the guidance of a high-capacity teacher network for semantic segmentation. A broad range of KD approaches [ 10 , 13 , 14 ] have been well studied but mostly for image classification tasks. Unlike image-level recognition, the segmentation task aims at dense pixel predictions, which is more challenging. Previous researches [ 15 ] have found that directly utilizing classification-based KD methods to deal with dense prediction tasks may not achieve desirable performance. This is because strictly aligning the coarse feature maps between the teacher and student networks may lead to negative constraints and ignore the structured context among pixels.
blocks.zh: 本文调查了KD在高能教师网络的指导下改进紧凑学生网络的性能,用于语义分解. 广泛研究了KD方法[10,13,14],但大多是为了图像分类任务. 与图像级别的识别不同,分解任务旨在进行密集的像素预测,这更具挑战性. 先前的研究[15]发现,直接使用基于分类的KD方法处理密集的预测任务可能无法实现理想的性能. 这是因为严格调整师生网络之间的粗糙地物图可能导致负面限制,并忽略像素之间的结构上下文.

blocks.en: Recent studies attempt to propose specialized KD methods [ 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] for semantic segmentation, mainly divided into relation- and feature-based distillation methods. Most relation-based distillation studies focus on mining correlations or dependencies among spatial pixel locations because segmentation needs a structured output. Typical knowledge can be local pixel affinity [ 16 , 21 ] , global pairwise relations [ 17 , 18 , 22 ] and intra-class pixel variation [ 19 ] . Such methods often perform better than traditional point-wise alignment in capturing structured spatial knowledge. However, previous segmentation KD methods often guide a student to mimic the teacher’s structured information generated from an individual image sample . They ignore cross-image semantic relations among pixels for knowledge transfer, as shown in Figure 1 . Therefore, they only construct narrow context but cannot capture wide contextual dependencies across global images.
blocks.zh: 最近的研究试图为语义分解提出专门的KD方法[16,17,18,19,20,21,22,23],主要分为关系分解和特征分解法. 大多数以关系为基础的蒸馏研究侧重于空间像素位置之间的采矿关联或依赖性,因为分解需要结构化输出. 典型的知识可以是局部像素亲和性[16,21],全球对等关系[17,18,22]和类内同位素变异[19]. 这种方法在捕捉结构化空间知识方面往往比传统的点对接效果更好。 然而,之前的分解 KD 方法往往引导学生模仿从单个图像样本中生成的老师结构化信息. 如图1所显示,它们忽略了像素之间用于知识转让的跨图像语义关系。 因此,它们只构建狭义的上下文,但不能捕捉全球图像的广泛上下文依存。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose Cross-Image Relational Knowledge Distillation V2 (CIRKDV2) for semantic segmentation. To capture wide contextual dependencies, we aim to construct global relations across the whole training images from both the teacher and student. A good pre-trained teacher network with high performance could often generate a well-structured embedding space and capture better correlations than a student network. Based on this property, we distill pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations across various images from the teacher to the student. This helps the student fully explore multi-dimensional structured relations to learn long-range contextual dependencies. The pixel-to-pixel and channel-to-channel distillation aims to transfer similarity distributions among pixel and channel embeddings, respectively. The channel embedding means a semantic map along the channel dimension of a feature map. The pixel-to-region distillation focuses on transferring pixel-to-region similarity distributions between pixel and region embeddings. The region embedding is generated by averagely pooling pixel embeddings from the same class and represents the feature center of that class. The pixel-to-region relations indicate the relative similarities between pixels and class-wise prototypes.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题,我们提出跨图像相通知识分解V2(CIRKDV2)用于语义分解. 为了了解广泛的背景依赖性,我们的目标是在师生的整个培训图像中构建全球关系。 具有高性能的良好预训教师网络,往往可以产生出结构完善的嵌入空间并捕捉出比学生网络更好的相关性. 基于这个属性,我们蒸馏出像素到像素,像素到地区,以及从老师到学生的各种图像之间的通道到通道的关系. 这有助于学生充分探索多维结构关系来学习长距离背景依赖. 相像素到相像素和相道到相道蒸馏分别旨在将相相像素和相道嵌入相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 通道嵌入指沿特征地图的通道维度绘制的语义图. 像素到区域的分馏注重将像素到区域的相近分布转移到像素到区域的嵌入. 区域嵌入由平均集合像素嵌入从同类生成,并代表该类的特征中心. 像素对地区关系表明像素与类地原型的相对相似.

blocks.en: A naive way for constructing cross-image relations is to derive embeddings from the current mini-batch. However, the batch size of the segmentation task is often small, limiting the network to capture broader pixel dependencies. Motivated by the memory mechanism in previous self-supervised learning [ 24 ] , we introduce a pixel queue, a region queue, and a channel queue in the memory bank to store abundant embeddings for modeling long-range relations. The embeddings in the queue are consistent in distribution during the distillation process, since they are generated from the pre-trained and frozen teacher network. We regard the teacher and student pixel embeddings from the current mini-batch as anchors, and then randomly sample contrastive pixel and region embeddings from queues to model pixel-to-pixel as well as pixel-to-region similarity distributions. In a similar manner, we regard channel embeddings from the current mini-batch as anchors, and then randomly sample channel embeddings from the channel queue to construct channel-to-channel similarity distributions. Then we align such similarity distributions via KL-divergence from the student to the teacher. This helps the student learn comprehensive structured relation knowledge from the teacher.
blocks.zh: 构建跨相像关系的天真方式是从目前的"小批"中衍生出嵌入. 然而,分块任务的批量尺寸往往很小,限制了网络捕捉更广泛的像素依赖性. 受前作自控学习的内存机制[24]所激励,我们引入了像素队列,区域队列,以及内存库中的频道队列来存储大量嵌入来进行模型长距离关系. 队列中的嵌入物在蒸馏过程中分布一致,因为它们由被预先训练并被冻结的教师网络所产生. 我们把师生嵌入自当前小批次的像素视为锚地,再从队列随机抽样对比像素和区域嵌入至模型像素到像素以及像素到区域相似分布. 同样,我们将当前小批次上嵌入的频道视为主播,再从频道队列上随机抽取频道嵌入,以构建频道相近分布. 然后我们通过学生的KL-潜水将这种相似性分布与老师一致. 这有助于学生从教师那里学习全面的结构性关系知识。

blocks.en: Beyond popular relation-based distillation, feature-based distillation is also demonstrated as an important technique. Shu et al. [ 20 ] revealed that each channel represents a category-specific mask and thus proposed Channel-Wise Distillation (CWD). CWD demonstrates the importance of channel-level information for dense prediction tasks. More recently, LAD [ 23 ] transfers the classical FitNet idea to semantic segmentation for raw feature distillation. However, previous methods often perform direct alignment without contextual modeling for student pixels, leading to possible mismatching semantics between the teacher and student. This is because the teacher is often equipped with a larger kernel than the student, which means that the teacher pixel extracts semantic information from a wider receptive field. To mitigate the semantic gap, we propose context aggregation over the spatial dimension of the student feature map to augment pixel embeddings with wider contextual information. And then we perform feature distillation of pixel embeddings between the student and teacher. This helps the student learn meaningful pixel semantics from the teacher without negative receptive field gaps.
blocks.zh: 除了以流行关系为基础的蒸馏,以特征为基础的蒸馏也被证明是一种重要的技术. 舒等编. [20] 透露出每个频道代表一个特定类别的口罩,从而提出频道-Wise Distillation(CWD). CWD展示了频道级信息对于密集预测任务的重要性. 最近,LAD[23]将古典FitNet的想法转移到了原始特征蒸馏的语义分解. 然而,之前的方法往往在不为学生像素进行上下文模型的情况下进行直接对接,导致师生之间可能出现语义不匹配. 这是因为老师往往配备了比学生更大的内核,这意味着老师像素从更广泛的可接受领域提取语义信息. 为了缩小语义上的差距,我们建议在学生特征图的空间维度上进行上下文汇总,以用更广泛的上下文信息来增强像素嵌入. 然后我们在师生之间 进行像素嵌入的特征分解 这有助于学生从老师那里学习有意义的像素语义,没有负面的可接受字段差距.

blocks.en: In summary, CIRKDV2 leverages pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel dimensions for cross-image relational distillation, and contextual feature distillation to improve the student’s segmentation performance under the guidance of a strong teacher. We evaluate our method over popular DeepLabV3 [ 2 ] , PSPNet [ 3 ] , UperNet [ 25 ] , and SegFormer [ 26 ] architectures with various backbones on four challenging semantic segmentation benchmark datasets: Cityscapes [ 27 ] , ADE20K [ 28 ] , Pascal VOC [ 29 ] , and COCO-Stuff-164K [ 30 ] . Experimental results indicate that CIRKDV2 achieves the best performance among the state-of-the-art distillation approaches, demonstrating the effectiveness of cross-image relational distillation and contextual feature distillation in semantic segmentation.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,CIRKDV2利用了像素到像素,像素到地区,以及跨相像关系蒸馏的通道到通道维度,以及背景特征蒸馏,在强师的指导下提高学生分化性能. 我们评价我们的方法超越了流行的DeepLabV3 [2],PSPNet [3],UperNet [25],以及SegFormer [26] 四个具有挑战性的语义分解基准数据集:城市景观[27],ADE20K [28],Pascal VOC [29],以及COCO-Stuff-164K [30]。 实验结果显示CIRKDV2在最先进的分解法中取得了最佳的性能,证明了跨图像关系分解和语义分解上上下文特征分解的效果.

blocks.en: Parts of this paper, including pixel-to-pixel and pixel-to-region distillation, were published originally in our conference version [ 31 ] . This paper extends our earlier work in several valuable aspects for relation and feature distillation. The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose cross-image relational KD by modeling pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relations assisted by a memory bank mechanism for structured knowledge transfer. This helps the student learn comprehensive long-range semantic dependencies of various object segments across the whole images. • We propose contextual feature distillation by using context aggregation to augment student pixel embeddings with wider contextual information and then performing feature alignment between the teacher and student. This also avoids the semantic mismatching problem occurred in traditional feature distillation studies. • CIRKDV2 achieves the best performance among the state-of-the-art distillation methods across various architectures on four challenging semantic segmentation datasets.
blocks.zh: 本文的部分内容,包括像素到像素和像素到区域蒸馏,最初发表在我们的会议版本[31]. 本文件在关系和特征分解方面扩展了我们先前的工作。 主要贡献概述如下: 我们提出跨相像关系KD,通过建模像素到相像素,相像素到相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这有助于学生在整个图像中学习各种物体段的全面远程语义依赖。 我们建议通过使用上下文聚合来增强学生像素嵌入,提供更广泛的上下文信息,然后在教师和学生之间进行上下文调整。 这也避免了传统特征分馏研究中发生的语义不匹配问题. • CIRKDV2在四个具有挑战性的语义分解数据集上,在各种架构中最先进的分解方法中取得了最佳的性能。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Knowledge Distillation for Image Classification
blocks.zh: II-A 图像分类知识分解

blocks.en: The core idea of KD [ 10 ] is to transfer meaningful knowledge from a cumbersome teacher into a smaller and faster student. Most current KD methods deal with image classification networks, mainly divided into probability-based, feature-based, and relation-based approaches. Probability-based KD [ 10 ] transfers the class probabilities produced by the teacher as soft labels to supervise the student. Feature-based KD focuses on intermediate feature maps [ 32 ] or their refined information [ 33 ] as knowledge. Relation-based KD [ 34 , 35 , 36 ] aligns correlations or dependencies among multiple instances between the student and teacher networks. However, these image-level KD methods are often unsuitable for pixel-wise semantic segmentation [ 15 ] , because the latter needs more fine-grained structured knowledge.
blocks.zh: KD[10]的核心思想是将有意义的知识从烦琐的老师转移到更小更快的学生身上. 大多数目前的KD方法处理图像分类网络,主要分为概率法,特征法和关系法. 基于概率的KD [10] 转移了由老师生产的班级概率作为软标签来监督学生. 基于地物的KD注重中间地物图[32]或其精细信息[33]作为知识. 基于关系的KD [34, 35, 36] 将学生和教师网络之间多种实例之间的关联性或依赖性相协调. 然而,这些图像级的KD方法往往不适合像素-智慧语义分解[15],因为后者需要更精细的结构化知识.

blocks.en: II-B Relation-based Distillation for Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-B 语义分解基于关系分解

blocks.en:
Existing KD methods for semantic segmentation can be divided into relation-based and feature-based approaches, where relation KD has become a mainstream paradigm. The core idea of relation-based KD is to encode contextual pixel or channel affinity as valuable knowledge for transfer. The main differences among existing work lie in how to construct relationships. Xie et al. [ 16 ] align local similarity maps constructed from 8 neighborhood pixels between the student and teacher networks. He et al. [ 18 ] transfer non-local pairwise affinity maps using an autoencoder to minimize the discrepancy of features. SKD [ 17 , 15 ] performs pairwise similarity distillation among pixels and an adversarial distillation of score maps. IFVD [ 19 ] distills intra-class feature variation to learn more robust relations with class-wise prototypes. DSD [ 37 ] constructs pixel-wise and category-wise similarity distillation, where the former uses residual attention maps to strengthen fine-grained spatial relations, and the latter aims to learn category correlation. APD [ 21 ] mines sample-wise contextual information by an adaptive local perspective.
Af-DCD [ 22 ] distills dense structured relations from channel and spatial dimensions primarily within the current image or mini-batch feature structure . CIRKDV2 changes the knowledge being transferred: it models channel-to-channel relations across global images by using teacher channel embeddings stored in an online memory queue. Thus, each current student channel is not only compared with channels from the same image, but also with a broader set of teacher channel embeddings collected from previous images. This transfers dataset-level channel correlation patterns that are not available from an individual image alone.
blocks.zh:
现有的语义分解的KD方法可以分为基于关系的方法和基于特征的方法,其中关系KD已经成为主流范式. 基于关系KD的核心理念是将上下文像素或信道亲和性编码为可转让的宝贵知识. 现有工作的主要区别在于如何构建关系。 谢等. [16] 校对从学生和教师网络之间的8个相邻像素所构建的本地相似度地图. 他等编. [18] 使用自编码器传输非本地对等相近图,以尽量减少特性相差. SKD [17,15]在像素中进行对等分衍射并进行对等分数图的对等分衍射. IFVD [19] 衍射出类内特征变异,以学习与类内原型更强的关系. DSD [37]构造了像素相向和类相相相向的衍射法,前者使用剩余关注图来强化细纹空间关系,后者旨在学习类相相相相相向. APD[21] 地雷取样从适应当地角度提供背景信息。
AF-DCD [22]主要从当前图像或小批量地物结构中从通道和空间维度中提炼出密集的结构关系。 CIRKDV2改变正在转移的知识:它通过使用存储在在线内存队列中的师道嵌入来模拟跨全球图像的频道对频道关系. 因此,目前每个学生频道不仅与同一图像的频道相提并论,而且与从以往图像中收集的更宽广的教师频道嵌入相提并论. 这样可以传输单个图像中无法提供的数据集级通道关联模式.

blocks.en: Although the above relation-based distillation methods achieve good performance, their common weakness is that the relational modeling is only limited in an individual image, which cannot capture long-range pixel dependencies. By contrast, CIRKDV2 proposes pixel-to-pixel and pixel-to-region distillation by sampling pixels from an online memory bank. Compared to the mini-batch, the memory bank significantly increases the number of available pixels for affinity modeling. Therefore, the student can learn longer-range pixel dependencies.
blocks.zh: 虽然上述基于关系的蒸馏方法取得了良好的性能,但其共同的弱点是,关系模型化只在单个图像中受到限制,无法捕捉到长距离像素的依赖性. 相形之下,CIRKDV2则通过从在线内存库中取样像素来提出像素到像素和像素到区域蒸馏. 相较于"小批量",内存库大大增加了可供亲和模型使用的像素. 因此,学生可以学习更远的像素依赖.

blocks.en: II-C Feature-based Distillation for Semantic Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-C 语义分解基于特性的分解

blocks.en: Beyond relation-based distillation, some studies examine feature-based distillation to improve the representational capability of the student network. Different from affinity modeling along the spatial dimension, CWD [ 20 ] conducts channel-wise distillation to guide each student channel to mimic the corresponding teacher channel, where a channel often represents a semantic mask. SSTKD [ 38 , 39 ] distills structural and statistical texture features to let the student learn low-level detail information from the teacher. Attention distillation [ 33 ] has been widely used for image classification. The attention map [ 40 ] often emphasizes meaningful semantic information while ignoring meaningless regions. The core idea of attention distillation is to make the student learn critical semantic information by mimicking the teacher’s attention maps. This idea is also extended to semantic segmentation. CAT [ 41 ] distills class attention maps to guide the student to focus on class-discriminative regions of the teacher. AttnFD [ 42 ] introduces CBAM [ 40 ] to extract channel and spatial attention maps and performs alignment between teacher and student. LAD [ 23 ] revisits the seminal work FitNet [ 32 ] and conducts feature distillation from l 2 l_{2} -normalized raw features.
blocks.zh: 除了基于关系的蒸馏外,一些研究还研究了基于特征的蒸馏,以提高学生网络的代表能力. 与沿着空间维度的亲和模型不同,CWD[20]进行频道相向分馏,以引导每个学生频道模仿对应的教师频道,该频道经常代表一个语义口罩. SSTKD [38,39] 提炼出结构和统计纹理特征,让学生从老师那里学习到低级的详细信息. 注意分馏[33]被广泛用于图像分类. 关注图 [40] 经常强调有意义的语义信息,而忽略了毫无意义的区域. 注意力分馏的核心思想是通过模仿老师的注意力图来让学生学习批评语义信息. 这一想法还被扩展至语义分化. CAT [41] 提炼出班级关注地图,以引导学生关注教师的班级歧视区域. AttnFD [42] 介绍 CBAM [40] 取出频道和空间关注地图,并实现师生对接. LAD [23] 重温了"FitNet"的开创性作品 [32] 并进行从l 2 l_{--正态化原始特征的特征分馏.

blocks.en: Being orthogonal to relation-based distillation, feature-based distillation is also a complementary way to improve the student network. Previous feature-based methods often perform simple alignment between feature maps without high-level feature modeling. By contrast, we propose contextual modeling to augment feature representations, facilitating knowledge transfer of valuable high-level semantic information.
blocks.zh: 与以关系为基础的蒸馏正交,以特征为基础的蒸馏也是改进学生网络的一种补充方式. 以前基于地物的方法经常在地物图之间进行简单的对接,而不进行高层次地物模型化. 相比之下,我们建议建立背景模型,以增加专题表述,促进宝贵的高级语义信息的知识转让。

blocks.en: III-B Overview of CIRKDV2
blocks.zh: CIRKDV2概览

blocks.en: A unified framework is shown in Figure 2 , which illustrates the complete pipeline of CIRKDV2. Compared to the previous CIRKD, CIRKDV2 is an omni-dimensional distillation framework, including not only pixel-to-pixel distillation and pixel-to-region distillation, but also channel-to-channel distillation, channel feature distillation and contextual feature distillation.
blocks.zh: 图2显示了一个统一的框架,其中说明了CIRKDV2的完整管道. 与之前的CIRKD相比,CIRKDV2是一个全相维分馏框架,不仅包括像素到像素分馏和像素到区域分馏,还包括通道到通道分馏,通道特征分馏和上下文特征分馏.

blocks.en: Semantic segmentation requires both spatially structured prediction and channel-wise semantic discrimination. Pixel-to-pixel distillation captures long-range spatial dependencies among pixels. Pixel-to-region distillation captures the relation between pixel embeddings and class-wise semantic prototypes. Channel-to-channel distillation captures the correlations among semantic response maps. These three dimensions are complementary: the first two focus on spatial/category-level structure, while the third focuses on semantic-channel interaction.
blocks.zh: 语义分解既需要空间结构化的预测,又需要通向通道的语义区分. 像素到像素蒸馏可以捕捉到像素之间的长距离空间依赖. Pixel-to-region 衍射能捕捉到像素嵌入和类语义原型之间的关系. 通道到通道分馏能捕捉到语义反应图之间的关联. 这3个维是互补的:前两个以空间/类别层次结构为重点,而第三个则以语义-通道相互作用为重点.

blocks.en: Cross-image relational distillation transfers structural knowledge by aligning similarity distributions. However, relation losses mainly constrain relative similarities, not the absolute semantic content of each pixel embedding. Contextual feature distillation complements this by providing a direct teacher-guided semantic alignment after context aggregation. Therefore, it serves as a semantic anchor for the relational framework.
blocks.zh: 跨图像关系分馏通过对等相似性分布来转移结构知识. 然而,关系损失主要制约相对相似性,而不是每个像素嵌入的绝对语义内容. 上下文特征分解通过在上下文汇总后提供直接的由教师指导的语义校正来补充这一点. 因此,它充当关系框架的语义主干站。

blocks.en:
Motivation. Although the training objectives of L t ​ a ​ s ​ k L_{task} and L k ​ d L_{kd} are widely used in semantic segmentation, they only deal with pixel-wise predictions independently but neglect semantic relations between pixels. Some segmentation KD methods [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] attempt to capture spatial relational knowledge by modeling pixel affinity. Nevertheless, these KD methods
only construct the relationships among pixels within a single image , regardless of the semantic dependencies among pixels across global images. This paper demonstrates that cross-image relational knowledge is also valuable for conducting teacher-student-based KD.

Inspired by the recent memory-based contrastive learning [ 24 , 43 ] , we may retrieve pixel embeddings of other images from the current mini-batch or an online memory bank . blocks.en: Although mini-batch-based distillation could capture cross-image relations to some extent, it is difficult to model dependencies among pixels from global images, since the batch size per GPU of segmentation task is often small, e.g. 1 or 2. To address this problem, we introduce an online pixel queue that can store massive pixel embeddings in the memory bank generated from the past mini-batches. It allows us to retrieve abundant embeddings efficiently. The usage of memory bank dates back to self-supervised learning [ 24 ] . This is because a large number of negative samples are pivotal for unsupervised contrastive learning, and the mini-batch size limits available contrastive samples.
blocks.zh: 虽然基于小批量的蒸馏可以在一定程度上捕捉到跨相像关系,但很难从全球图像中模拟像素的依赖性,因为分块任务的每GPU批量大小往往很小,例如1或2. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了一个在线像素队列,可以将大量像素嵌入由过去小管所生成的内存库. 它可以有效回收大量嵌入物。 记忆库的使用可以追溯到自我监督的学习[24]. 这是因为大量的负面样本对于无监督的对比性学习至关重要,而小批量大小限制了现有的对比性样本.

blocks.en:
In the context of the dense segmentation task, each image would contain a vast number of pixel samples, and most pixels in the same object region are often homogeneous. Therefore, storing all pixel embeddings may learn redundant relational knowledge and slow down the distillation process. Moreover, saving several last batches to the queue may also damage the diversity of pixel embeddings. Thus we maintain a class-aware pixel queue 𝑸 p ∈ ℝ C × N p × D \bm{Q}_{p}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times N_{p}\times D} , where N p N_{p} is the number of pixel embeddings per class and D D is the embedding size. For each image in the mini-batch, we only randomly sample a small number, i.e. V V ( V ≪ N p V\ll N_{p} ), of pixel embeddings from the same class and push them into the pixel queue 𝑸 p \bm{Q}_{p} . The queue is progressively
updated under the “first-in-first-out” strategy as distillation proceeds.

blocks.zh: III-C 3 以记忆为基础的像素到Region分解

blocks.en: Discrete pixel embeddings may not fully capture image content. Therefore, we introduce an online region queue that can store massive more representative region embeddings in the memory bank. Beyond pixel-to-pixel distillation, we further construct pixel-to-region distillation to model the relations between pixels and class-wise region embeddings across global images. Each region embedding represents the feature center of one semantic class in an image. We formulate the region embedding of a class by averagely pooling all the pixel embeddings belonging to that class in a single image.

Unlike spatial dimension, the teacher and student with independent training often show different semantics in the same channel location. To promote channel-to-channel distillation, the same channel location should have similar semantics between teacher and student as the prerequisite. To align channel semantics between teacher and student, we first apply a Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss for each channel: L c ​ h ​ a ​ n ​ n ​ e ​ l ​ _ ​ f ​ d = 1 D ∑ d = 1 D ‖ 𝐅 n | : , d s − 𝐅 n | : , d t ‖ F 2 . When the student and teacher have different feature dimensions, we first attach a lightweight projection head to the student feature map. The projection head consists of two 1×1 convolutional layers with batch normalization and ReLU. It maps the student feature dimension to the teacher feature dimension. Eq. ( 9 ) is then applied after this projection. The projection head is only used during training and is discarded during inference.
We would like to clarify that we do not assume that the original student channels and teacher channels are naturally aligned. The one-to-one alignment is therefore performed in the projected space , rather than between the original raw channels of two heterogeneous networks.

blocks.en: III-E Feature Distillation with Context Aggregation
blocks.zh: 三-E 特性在上下文中的消化

blocks.en: Cross-image relational modeling often captures structured knowledge. Beyond relation distillation, feature distillation [ 32 , 47 ] has been demonstrated to reduce the performance gap between teacher and student. We further explore feature distillation of pixel embeddings to increase the similarity of pixel-wise representations between teacher and student. The traditional feature distillation methods often directly align pixel-wise embeddings from the original teacher and student feature maps. However, the pixels over the same spatial location from teacher and student may not have consistent semantics, since the teacher is often equipped with a larger kernel size than the student, which means that the teacher pixel extracts semantic information from a wider receptive field.
blocks.zh: 跨图像关系模型往往能捕捉到结构化的知识. 在关系分馏之外,还演示了特征分馏[32,47]来缩小师生之间的性能差距. 我们进一步探索了像素嵌入的特征分馏,以增加师生之间像素相近的表示. 传统的特征分馏方法往往直接将原始师生特征图中以像素为导向的嵌入相对齐. 然而,来自师生的相同空间位置上的像素可能没有一致的语义,因为师生往往配备了比学生更大的内核尺寸,这意味着师生像素从更广泛的可接受领域提取语义信息.

The context aggregation module can indeed be viewed as an auxiliary distillation head during training. However, it is not used to enhance the inference-time capacity of the student. Instead, it provides a teacher-compatible feature transformation for the distillation objective.
It is a training-only semantic adapter that improves the quality of feature distillation without introducing any inference overhead. This is consistent with many distillation methods that use auxiliary heads or projection layers during training and remove them during inference.

Datasets. We employ four popular semantic segmentation datasets to conduct our experiments. 1. Cityscapes [ 27 ] is an urban scene parsing dataset that contains 5000 finely annotated images, where 2,975/500/1525 images are used for train/val/test . The segmentation performance is reported on 19 classes. 2. ADE20K [ 28 ] contains 20K/2K/3K images for train/val/test with 150 semantic categories under diverse scenes. 3. Pascal VOC [ 29 ] is a visual object segmentation dataset that includes 20 foreground object categories and one background class. We adopt the augmented data with extra annotations provided by Hariharan et al. [ 49 ] . The resulting dataset contains 10,582/1,449/1,456 images for train/val/test . 4. training, 5K for validation, 20K for test-dev, and 20K for the test-challenge. It covers 172 classes: 80 thing classes, 91 stuff classes, and 1 class “unlabeled”.

blocks.en: Network architectures. Besides SegFormer [ 26 ] , we use the segmentation framework DeepLabV3 [ 2 ] with ResNet-101 backbone [ 51 ] as the powerful teacher network. For student networks, we use diverse segmentation architectures to verify the effectiveness of distillation methods. Specifically, we adopt various combinations of DeepLabV3, PSPNet [ 3 ] , and UperNet [ 25 ] with different light-weight backbones of ResNet-18 [ 51 ] , MobileNetV3 [ 52 ] , and MobileViT [ 53 ] . For SegFormer [ 26 ] distillation, the teacher and student backbones are MiT-B4 and MiT-B0, respectively. All backbones are initialized by pretrained weights from ImageNet-1K [ 54 ] .
blocks.zh: 网络建筑. 除了SegFormer [26],我们使用分块框架 DeepLabV3 [2] 以ResNet-101为主干线 [51] 作为强大的教师网络. 对于学生网络,我们使用不同的分解结构来验证分解方法的有效性. 具体地说,我们采用了DeepLabV3、PSPNet[3]和UperNet[25]的各种组合,它们具有不同的轻量级主干网ResNet-18[51]、MobileNetV3[52]和MobileViT[53]。 对于SegFormer [26] 蒸馏,师生骨干分别为MiT-B4和MiT-B0. 所有骨干由从ImageNet-1K[54]中被预先训练出重量来初始化.

For other datasets, the batch size is 16, and the initial learning rate is 0.02. The number of the total training iterations is 80K. Following the official setup [ 26 ] , SegFormer is optimized by AdamW with an initial learning rate 0.0002 and weight decay 0.0001. blocks.en: IV-B Results on Cityscapes
blocks.zh: 四-B 城市景观结果

blocks.en: In Table I , we compare our proposed CIRKDV2 against popular distillation methods on Cityscapes over CNN-based segmentation architectures. We can observe that all segmentation distillation methods improve student networks under the teacher’s supervision. CIRKDV2 achieves the best segmentation performance across various student networks with homogeneous or heterogeneous architecture styles. Notice that LAD [ 23 ] , a feature-based distillation method, is often superior in the homogeneous architecture pair like ResNet-101 and ResNet-18, but inferior in the heterogeneous architecture pair like ResNet-101 and MobileNetV3. By contrast, relation-based methods, like CIRKD [ 31 ] , Af-DCD [ 22 ] , and CIRKDV2, do not rely on architecture-specific cues. Moreover, CIRKDV2 outperforms the previous state-of-the-art CIRKD, Af-DCD, and LAD methods with 0.70%, 0.88%, and 0.98% improvements on average across four CNN-based models, respectively. Table II shows the distillation results on MobileViT-XXS, a light-weight vision transformer for mobile devices. CIRKDV2 obtains 0.94%, 0.84%, and 1.66% mIoU gains on average compared to CIRKD, Af-DCD, and LAD, respectively. As shown in Table III , we further evaluate distillation methods on SegFormer. CIRKDV2 achieves the best performance and surpasses the second-best CIRKD by 0.65%. The results demonstrate that CIRKDV2 can also bring remarkable improvements on transformer architectures. The superiority of CIRKDV2 may be attributed to distilling more comprehensive knowledge than previous feature- and relation-based methods.

blocks.en: T-SNE visualization of learned feature embeddings on the student network by LAD and our proposed CIRKDV2 is shown in Figure 8 . Compared to LAD, the network trained by CIRKDV2 shows a more discriminative pixel-wise semantic feature space. The visual result suggests that learning cross-image relations with pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel dimensions from the teacher network can guide the student to learn comprehensive knowledge, helping the student achieve better intra-class compactness and inter-class separability, thus improving segmentation performance.

blocks.en: IV-C Results on ADE20K
blocks.zh: ADE20K结果

blocks.en: In Table IV , we evaluate various distillation methods on ADE20K. ADE20K is a popular semantic segmentation benchmark and more challenging than Cityscapes. CIRKDV2 also achieves the best performance across various segmentation frameworks. It surpasses previous state-of-the-art CIRKD, Af-DCD, and LAD methods by 0.89%, 0.69%, and 0.91% on average across four networks, respectively. The results manifest that CIRKDV2 can also work well on more diverse scenes.
blocks.zh: 在表四中,我们评价ADE20K的各种蒸馏方法。 ADE20K是一个受欢迎的语义分解基准,比Cityscapes更具挑战性. CIRKDV2还实现了各个分块框架的最佳性能. 它在4个网络中分别分别以0.89%、0.69%和0.91%超过以往最先进的CIRKD、Af-DCD和LAD方法。 结果显示,CIRKDV2也可以在更多样化的场景上很好地发挥作用.

blocks.en: IV-D Results on Pascal VOC
blocks.zh: 关于Pascal VOC的结果

blocks.en:
Beyond scene-parsing datasets, we also evaluate our CIRKDV2 on Pascal VOC, a representative visual object segmentation dataset. As shown in Table V , CIRKDV2 achieves the best performance compared to other segmentation KD approaches.
Compared to the previous state-of-the-art CIRKD, Af-DCD, and LAD methods, CIRKDV2 results in 0.74%, 0.64%, and 0.96% improvements across four segmentation models on average, respectively. The results indicate that CIRKDV2 can lead to accurate semantic masks on visual object segmentation.
blocks.zh:
除了场景分解数据集外,我们还在Pascal VOC上评价了我们的CIRKDV2,这是一个具有代表性的视觉物体分解数据集. 如表五所示,CIRKDV2与其他分解KD方法相比,实现了最佳性能.
相较于之前最先进的CIRKD,Af-DCD和LAD方法,CIRKDV2平均在四个分化模型中分别取得了0.74%,0.64%和0.96%的改进. 结果显示CIRKDV2可以在视觉物体分解上导致准确的语义口罩.

blocks.en: IV-E Results on COCO-Stuff-164K
blocks.zh: COCO-Stuff-164K结果

blocks.en: As shown in Table VI , we compare various distillation methods on COCO-Stuff-164K. COCO-Stuff-164K is a large-scale semantic segmentation dataset and has more complex scenes and objects. CIRKDV2 performs the best consistently among the existing segmentation distillation methods. It brings 0.62%, 0.52%, and 0.76% mIoU gains over CIRKD, Af-DCD, and LAD methods on average across four networks, respectively. The promising results demonstrate the good scalability of our CIRKDV2 to work reasonably well on large-scale and complex scenes.
blocks.zh: 如表六所示,我们比较了COCO-Stuff-164K的各种蒸馏方法。 COCO-Stuff-164K是一个大规模的语义分解数据集,有更复杂的场景和对象. CIRKDV2在现有的分解蒸馏方法中表现得最好。 平均而言,这在四个网络中分别带来0.62%、0.52%和0.76%的MIOU收益。 这些有希望的结果表明,我们的CIRKDV2在大规模和复杂的场景上可以很好地发挥效力。

The teacher is a pretrained SAM model with a high-performance ViT-Large image encoder. As shown in Table VII , CIRKDV2 achieves 3.16% and 1.89% mIoU improvements compared to the baseline and MobileSAM on the challenging COCO-Stuff-164K, respectively. The results demonstrate that CIRKDV2 can also be effectively extended to SAM foundation models.

blocks.en: As shown in Table VIII , we compare our CIRKDV2 with Af-DCD and LAD methods, which represent the state-of-the-art relation and feature distillation works, respectively. The training time is recorded from one training step with a batch size of 16 on 8 NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPUs. LAD achieves the best training efficiency because it aligns feature maps without sophisticated relational modeling between teacher and student. Both Af-DCD and CIRKDV2 are relation-based distillation methods. Compared to Af-DCD, CIRKDV2 needs extra 6.25% training time and 19.39% GPU memory costs but results in the best 39.82% mIoU. The good performance justifies the minor increase of training costs. Notice that all distillation methods do not change the student network architecture, therefore, the inference time and memory are the same as the original baseline network without distillation.

Af-DCD和CIRKDV2都是以关系为基础的蒸馏方法. 与AF-DCD相比,CIRKDV2需要额外的6.25%的训练时间和19.39%的GPU内存成本,但结果达到了39.82%的mIoU最佳. 良好的业绩证明培训费用略有增加。 注意所有分馏方法都不会改变学生网络架构,因此,推论时间和内存与原基线网络相同而无需分馏.

blocks.en: V-B Ablation of context aggregation for feature distillation
blocks.zh: V-B 特性蒸馏的上下文汇总

blocks.en:
As shown in Table XIII , we conduct an ablation study of various context aggregation methods for feature distillation. The feature distillation without contextual aggregation only achieves a 0.41% mIoU gain over baseline. This is because the traditional feature distillation ignores that the teacher pixel has a wider receptive field than the student pixel. Although contextual aggregation with equal weights improves the traditional feature distillation by 0.32%, it neglects the correlation among contextual pixels.
The object contextual aggregation [ 57 ] absorbs object region representations to augment student pixels and boosts the equal contextual aggregation by 0.17%. We think the reason why object region representations lead to a marginal improvement is that the object-level coarse-grained representations do not contribute to the optimization of pixel-wise feature distillation. Our method introduces the attention mechanism for weighted pixel-level contextual aggregation and achieves the best 1.61% improvement over baseline. The results demonstrate that our method makes the student pixels learn better semantic information from the teacher. This is because our method widens the student receptive field and leads the student to learn matched pixel semantic information from the teacher.
blocks.zh:
如表十三所示,我们对特征分馏的各种上下文汇总方法进行了研究。 特性蒸馏没有上下文聚合,只能实现0.41%的mIoU比基线增益. 这是因为传统的特征分馏忽略了老师像素比学生像素有更宽广的可接受领域. 虽然具有等重的上下文聚合能使传统特征分馏率提高0.32%,但忽略了上下文像素之间的关联.
对象上下文聚合[57]吸收对象区域表示来增加学生像素,将等上下文集合提升0.17%. 我们认为,物体区域表示导致边际改进的原因是,物体级粗纹表示无助于优化像素相感特征分馏. 我们的方法引入了加权像素级背景汇总的注意机制,并实现了比基线最好的1.61%的改进. 结果显示,我们的方法使学生像素向老师学习更好的语义信息. 这是因为我们的方法拓宽了学生的接受领域,引导学生向老师学习相匹配的像素语义信息.

blocks.en: V-C Impact of the queue size
blocks.zh: V- C 队列大小的影响

blocks.en: We investigate the impact of memory sizes of the pixel queue, region queue, and channel queue. As shown in Appendix Figure R.1, distillation performance increases as the sizes of the pixel queue, region queue, and channel queue grow. This is because a larger queue could provide more abundant and diverse embeddings for capturing long-range dependencies. The results also show that the distillation performance saturates at a certain memory capacity. In summary, the pixel, region, and channel queues occupy 368MB, 40MB, and 92MB memory costs, which only account for < < 1% of the whole memory.
blocks.zh: 我们调查像素队列、区域队列和频道队列的内存大小的影响。 如附录图R.1所示,蒸馏性能随着像素队列的大小,区域队列,和频道队列的增大而增加. 这是因为更大的队列可以为捕捉长距离依赖性提供更丰富和多样的嵌入. 结果还表明蒸馏性能以一定的内存容量饱和. 总之,像素,区域和频道队列占据了368MB,40MB,和92MB的内存成本,它们只占了 < 1%的整个内存.

blocks.en: In our design, the region queue stores features generated by the frozen teacher network . Since the teacher is fixed, the stored region embeddings remain semantically invariant throughout training, therefore the “staleness” problem does not exist. In addition, we use a class-wise queue and class-balanced sampling. This prevents frequent categories from dominating the relation construction and ensures that rare classes can still be sampled once their region embeddings are stored. As shown in Figure 6 of our manuscript, the Cityscapes class-wise IoU analysis also shows gains than SOTA distillation method LAD on rare classes like wall, fence, and truck by 2.08%, 5.18% and 5.81% mIoUs, respectively. This indicates that the class-wise region queue does not harm rare classes. Instead, it helps preserve teacher-provided prototypes and makes them available to provide stable information for later iterations.
blocks.zh: 在我们的设计中,区域队列储存了由被冻结的教师网络产生的特性。 由于教师是固定的,所储存的嵌入区在整个培训过程中始终是无变化的,因此不存在“不稳定”问题。 此外,我们采用分级排队和分级平衡的抽样. 这使得频繁的分类无法主导关系构建,并确保稀有类在存储其区域嵌入后仍能被采样. 正如我们手稿图6所示,城市景观类IoU分析还显示,在墙壁、栅栏和卡车等稀有类别上,LAD比SOTA蒸馏法分别提高了2.08%、5.18%和5.81%。 这表明分级的区域队列不会损害稀有的类. 相反,它有助于保存教师提供的原型,并使它们为以后的迭代提供稳定的信息。

blocks.en: We investigate whether a large memory queue is more effective than a smaller but more frequently refreshed queue. In Table XIV and XV , the experiments are conducted on both CNN-based (DeepLabV3-ResNet-18) and Transformer-based (SegFormer-MiT-B0) architectures across Cityscapes and ADE20K. For DeepLabV3-ResNet-18, the large queue (20K, 16) achieves 75.26% and 38.77% mIoU on Cityscapes and ADE20K, respectively, outperforming the smaller queue (5K, 40) by 0.22% and 0.42% mIoU. Similarly, for SegFormer-MiT-B0, the large queue achieves 75.35% and 36.52% mIoU, exceeding the smaller queue by 0.17% and 0.25% mIoU. The intermediate configurations also exhibit a consistent trend of improved performance with larger queue capacities. These results suggest that preserving diverse historical embeddings is more beneficial than increasing the queue refresh rate in our cross-image relational distillation framework.
blocks.zh: 我们调查大型内存队列是否比小型但更频繁地刷新队列更有效. 在表十四和十五中,这些实验是在CNN(DeepLabV3-ResNet-18)和变形器(SegFormer-Mit-B0)建筑上进行的,跨越了Cityscapes和ADE20K. 对于DeepLabV3-ResNet-18,大队(20K,16)在城市景观和ADE20K上分别达到75.26%和38.77%的mIoU,比小队(5K,40)多出0.22%和0.42%的mIoU. 同样,对于SegFormer-Mit-B0,大队达到75.35%和36.52%的mIoU,比小队多出0.17%和0.25%的mIoU. 中间配置也显示出一种一贯的趋势,即以更大的排队能力改进业绩。 这些结果表明,保留各种历史嵌入比提高我们跨图像关系蒸馏框架中的队列刷新率更为有益。

blocks.en: V-D Impact of sampling methods
blocks.zh: 五维 取样方法的影响

blocks.en: As shown in Table XIII , we examine the impact of various sampling methods for memory-based distillation. “W/O sampling” means that the queue size is equal to the number of contrastive samples. “Hardest sampling” represents that we sample the hardest contrastive instances from the queues. Some previous studies [ 58 , 59 ] found that the hardest negatives may lead to bad local minima. To alleviate this problem, we attempt a semi-hard sampling strategy. We first collect the top 20% hardest negatives from the queues and then randomly sample contrastive instances from them. We found that “W/O sampling” is harmful to the performance gain, since this way decreases the queue size and range for modeling dependencies. Other advanced sampling methods, like hardest and semi-hard sampling, also do not produce improvements but introduce extra computation complexity. Finally, we choose random sampling, a simple yet effective way.
blocks.zh: 如表十三所示,我们审查了基于内存的蒸馏的各种取样方法的影响。 “W/O采样”是指队列大小等于对比样品的数量。 “最难的取样”表明,我们从排队中抽样了最难对比的事例。 以前的一些研究[58,59]发现,最困难的负数可能导致当地糟糕的迷你. 为了缓解这个问题,我们尝试了一种半硬性取样策略. 我们首先从队列中收集到前20%最硬的负数,然后从中随机抽取对比实例. 我们发现“W/O采样”对性能增益有害,因为这样会减少队列大小和建模依赖性的范围。 其他先进的采样方法,如最硬和半硬的采样方法,也并不产生改进,而是引入了额外的计算复杂性. 最后,我们选择随机抽样,一种简单而有效的方法。

blocks.en: In dense semantic segmentation, the memory bank is used to approximate the teacher’s dataset-level relational distribution, not only to mine the hardest negatives. A large queue provides diverse cross-image semantic contexts, while random class-balanced sampling gives a stable estimate of this global distribution. By contrast, hardest mining can overemphasize outliers, boundary pixels, mislabeled regions, or visually similar classes that are not reliable negatives. This may explain why hardest and semi-hard sampling introduce extra computation but do not improve performance.
blocks.zh: 在稠密的语义分解中,记忆库被用来近似于老师的数据集级关系分布,不仅用于去矿山最难的负数. 大队列提供不同的跨图像语义上下文,而随机的类平衡采样则给出了这一全球分布的稳定估计. 相比之下,最困难的开采可能过分强调外围点、边界像素、被误贴标签的区域,或非可靠底片的视觉类似类。 这或许可以解释为什么最难和半硬的取样采用额外计算,但不能改进性能。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents CIRKDV2, an improved cross-image relational KD method for efficient semantic segmentation. We construct pixel-to-pixel, pixel-to-region, and channel-to-channel relation modeling to transfer multi-dimensional structured knowledge for learning long-range pixel and channel dependencies. Moreover, we propose contextual feature distillation that first performs spatial context aggregation to augment the student pixels with richer contextual information and then aligns the augmented student pixels with the teacher pixels. Experiments on four challenging semantic segmentation datasets demonstrate that CIRKDV2 outperforms the state-of-the-art segmentation distillation methods. We hope our work can inspire future research to explore more advanced segmentation KD works towards global relational modeling and contextual feature distillation.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍CIRKDV2,是一种改进的跨图像关系KD方法,用于高效的语义分解. 我们构建了像素到像素,像素到区域,以及通道到通道关系模型,以传递多维结构化知识来学习远程像素和通道依赖性. 此外,我们建议进行背景特征分解,首先进行空间上下文聚合,用更丰富的背景信息来增强学生像素,然后将学生像素与教师像素相匹配。 对四个具有挑战性的语义分解数据集的实验表明CIRKDV2超越了最先进的分解分解方法. 我们希望我们的工作能够激励未来的研究,探索更先进的分块KD工作,以建立全球关系模型并进行背景特征分解.
